meta.title: RSVP to Gay Café 2026
meta.description: Join us for a festive coffee and pastry on the third Christmas day, 27 December.

opener.cardDescription: The invitation card reads: “Let them eat cake! Gay café”.

intro.heading: Join us for a festive coffee and pastry

invited.future: You are invited to enjoy and celebrate surviving another year (in this climate?). We will serve coffee (including milk alternatives), tea (without microplastics), cake, pie, and pastries.
invited.past: You were invited to enjoy and celebrate surviving another year (in this climate?). We served coffee (including milk alternatives), tea (without microplastics), cake, pie, and pastries.

price.future: The price is merely your attendance (it's free), monetary donations are welcome.
price.past: The price was merely your attendance (it's free), monetary donations are welcome.

intro.photoAlt: Tom making a coffee, whilst DJ is enjoying one

hours.future: The café will be open during the afternoon on the third Christmas day, from 12:00 to 17:28.
hours.past: The café was open during the afternoon on the third Christmas day, from 12:00 to 17:28.

transcript.hint: Choose a line to play the song from there.

countdown.now: The café is open right now!

handover.lead: Lovely on your phone, extra special on a big screen.
handover.subject: Gay Café 2026
handover.shareText: Open the Gay Café invitation on your computer: it's extra special on a big screen.

form.closed: You can no longer RSVP to this event. See you again next time!
form.whyContact: We're asking so we can update you if there are changes to this event.
form.rsvpLegend: Your RSVP: are we seeing you on Sunday, 27 December?

rsvp.0: Unfortunately no, but please invite me again next time
rsvp.-0: No, and do not invite me again

form.arrivalDescription: In order to assess if the city government is going to shut down our friends-gathering, please indicate the time you would like to come. We won't hold you to this, but it helps with planning!
form.allergiesDescription: It's very important to us that your visit does not result in an unexpected trip to the hospital, or hours on the toilet. Please indicate your allergies and intolerances.
form.drinksDescription: Indicate what you'd like to consume at our pop-up cafe. This helps us plan ahead.
form.addressNote: If you RSVPed yes, we will send our address and further details just before Christmas.

allergens.alcohol: Alcohol (including when processed, cooked, or as ingredient)
allergens.vegan: Anything non-vegan (select if you are vegan, not vegetarian)

reaction.0: Aww, we'll miss you! We'll keep a cup warm for next time.
reaction.-0: Understood. We won't invite you again.
reaction.1: Yay! A table for one, with the best seat in the house.
reaction.3: Yay! A table for three. We'll fetch an extra chair.
reaction.4: A party of four! We'll bake extra.

calendar.heading: Coming? Put it in your calendar:
calendar.about: Our pop-up café is open from 12:00 to 17:28. We will send the address just before Christmas. Please do not bring food: some of our friends are anaphylactic.
calendar.name: Name
calendar.changeOrCancel: To change or cancel your RSVP, email {contact}.

success.heading: Thank you for your RSVP!
success.reminder: Don't forget: the price is merely your attendance (it's free), monetary donations are welcome. Please do not bring food to protect our anaphylactic friends.
